opening.argument: The video is framed as a comparison of Internet Explorer, Chrome, and Firefox on Windows Vista, and the presenter states that he will test websites on each browser to see how well they run. The demonstrations examine website compatibility and playback behavior, including a visible YouTube playback error. A marketplace listing appears as another webpage-loading example, not as the point of the presentation. The conclusion returns to browser performance: one browser is described as the best of the three because it could load most, if not all, of the modern content tested. The commercial page does not change the purpose of the video from a technical comparison into a solicitation.

citations.quote: Which browser still works best on Vista in 2020? (Internet Explorer, Chrome & Firefox)
I'm going to test a few websites on each of these browsers to show you how well they run.
it was the best out of the three and was able to load most if not all of the modern content that we come to expect on the internet
